summary: Full catalog replacement (305 products / 7 categories / Product Master Excel import) verified end-to-end. Backend: 24/24 pytest tests pass — /api/categories returns exactly 7 categories with correct product_counts (food=159, spices=85, rice_grain_flour=13, personal_care=17, household=26, pooja_needs=4, healthcare=1), food/spices/personal_care have /api/static/categories/*.jpg that serve HTTP 200 (>1 KB payload), /api/products?category=<slug>&limit=500 returns the expected count for every slug, 20 random product images sampled all serve 200, ~23 products have image_url=null (private Drive — expected emoji fallback), /api/products?q=SWAD returns results and SWAD CHATPATE CHOLE RTE 450G exactly matches price_lek=820 / mrp_lek=1107 / discount=35 / weight='450 g' / image_url='/api/static/products/608171020041.jpg'. Cart→COD order flow still works (quick-user cart cleared after place-order). Admin /api/admin/products list returns 305 and filter by each of the 7 category slugs returns the expected counts; PATCH on a product persists via GET round-trip. Frontend (390x844 web preview, UI login flow): Home renders 7 category tiles — 3 with images (food, spices, personal_care) and 4 with emoji; 'Best sellers' show SWAD RTE products with '35% OFF' + struck '1107 L' + '820 L'. Food category screen shows '159 items' header; grid cards render with real images, 35% OFF badge, struck MRP + weight chip. Product detail (/product/<id>) renders real image, name 'SWAD CHATPATE CHOLE RTE 450G', '35% OFF' badge, struck '1107 L', selling '820 L', weight chip '450 g', and favourite heart. Search for 'SWAD' from the home search bar works. Admin UI: /admin/login with +355690000001/admin123 signs in, Products tab shows '305 products' header, dashboard top-sellers show SWAD products with new pricing. Discount DISPLAY rule confirmed (badge = DISCOUNT% field, struck = MRP — not an MRP-derived %).
action_items: Pre-existing (not new this iteration): React warning 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' still logs on web preview — low-priority theme migration.
Pre-existing (not new this iteration): React warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — minor; comes from category screen's addWrap <View pointerEvents="box-none">.
No functional issues found in this review request — catalog replace, image hosting, discount display, cart/checkout, and admin tabs all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/catalog.py: /api/products limit is capped at 500 via Query(ge=1, le=500) — matches the client-side limit raised in category screen. Good.

frontend/src/lib/product.ts discountInfo: correctly prefers explicit `discount` field as the badge % and uses `mrp_lek` (when > price_lek) as the struck price. Falls back to mrp-derived % only when `discount` is 0. Matches spec.

Observation (test harness only, NOT a product bug): directly injecting mbc_token+mbc_user into localStorage and then hard-navigating to /(tabs) triggers a 'Maximum update depth exceeded' error via @react-navigation useSyncExternalStore. Going through the real UI login flow does NOT reproduce it. Likely race between RootGate's useEffect re-running on fresh `segments` identity and the auth hydrate effect when storage is pre-populated before the provider boots. Keeping as low-priority tech-note; real users are unaffected.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of in-scope flows (home, category, product detail, search, admin login + products tab)

seed_data_creation: Cart CRUD + place-order test used quick-user-001 and added 2 food products at qty=2 each, then placed a COD order to Tirana. Cart is emptied by the place-order flow.
